# Test fixture provenance

`content_list.json` in this directory is a **real MinerU cloud output**, taken
from the OMSociety/dsh-mineru project (`test/fixtures/real-bcgm-6p/content_list.json`,
tag v1.0.0), distributed under the MIT License:
<https://github.com/OMSociety/dsh-mineru/blob/v1.0.0/LICENSE>.

- **Source sample:** a 6-page excerpt of the 1888 edition of 《本草纲目》
  (Compendium of Materia Medica), a public-domain text.
- **`content_list.json`:** the cloud's structured result (19 records — text, one
  image, page numbers). The original PDF is **not** bundled here; tests
  synthesize a 6-page PDF on the fly because the pipeline only needs the page
  count.
- **`expected-document.md`:** not copied from upstream. It was generated by
  **this** project's renderer (`lib/anchors.js` → `synthesizeDocument`) from the
  content list, then pinned so any anchor / page drift fails the byte-exact
  replay test. Regenerate it deliberately (and review the diff) if the renderer
  is intentionally changed.

No confidential material is present.
